text:
A two-lane gray asphalt road occupies the foreground and midground, underneath a concrete overpass. White painted lines mark the lanes. The upper-right corner of the image shows a square, dark gray building with a white rectangular section and what appears to be posters on its facade. To the left of the building is a white concrete overpass support structure, which also has a large opening that reveals greenery in the distance. To the immediate left is a tall traffic light pole with two dark gray pedestrian "Walk/Don't Walk" signs and a vertical stack of three dark gray traffic lights. The overpass support structure to the left is also concrete. A red and white striped traffic sign on a pole, with a red circle and white horizontal bar, is visible to the right of the building. In the bottom center, a three-pointed Mercedes-Benz logo, silver and reflective, is visible. It sits on a dark, reflective surface, likely the hood of a car.

On the left side of the road, a silver car is partially visible and parked near the edge of the frame. In the midground, a red and white diagonally striped traffic sign with a blue circular sign on top, indicating a left turn with a white arrow, is visible. To the left is a concrete sidewalk. Behind the sidewalk are several trees with green foliage. In the midground, to the right of the traffic light, two individuals are visible on bicycles, with their figures silhouetted against the bright background. Another individual on a bicycle is visible further to the left. A fourth person on a bicycle is also silhouetted in the distant background. Buildings and trees are visible in the background under a cloudy sky.

A vibrant urban street scene, with a dark gray asphalt road in the foreground and stretching into the background. The road is marked with white lines and arrows for traffic direction. In the foreground, a dark gray car partially visible at the bottom of the image. The center of the image shows a silver Volkswagen Golf car. To the left, a silver car is turning, and to the right, two dark gray cars are stationary.

On the left side of the road, groups of pedestrians, composed of seven people, are seen crossing the street on a white-striped crosswalk. Behind them, a gray-toned building with multiple windows. A traffic light, showing a red light, hangs above the traffic.

On the right side of the image, two additional pedestrians are seen crossing the street. In the mid-ground, a vibrant green tree and several other dark gray buildings are visible. The sky is partially visible through gaps in the tree leaves at the top of the image. Numerous traffic lights, utility poles, and street signs are scattered throughout the image, adding to the bustling urban atmosphere.

A dark grey asphalt road slopes slightly upwards towards the center, merging into the distance, with a Mercedes-Benz emblem visible on the lower edge. On the left side of the road, a narrow grey sidewalk extends into the distance, bordering a lush green vegetation strip and a fence. Behind the vegetation, three distinct buildings are visible, each with multiple floors and light-colored walls. In the foreground on the left, a dark-colored car is almost entirely hidden by a pole, which stands directly next to a pedestrian. A large green tree is centrally located, its branches curving over the top of the pole. Another tree and additional poles are visible further down the street. A lone car, with its headlights on, is partially visible in the distance, while several other cars line the right side of the road, facing the viewer. On the right, a row of approximately fifteen parked cars parallels the road, each varying in color.

A street scene with a dark grey road dominating the foreground and middle ground, marked with white arrow-shaped traffic signs indicating turns and straight-ahead directions. In the near foreground, at the bottom center, a metallic silver Mercedes-Benz logo is visible on a vehicle's hood, suggesting the viewpoint is from inside a car.

To the left, a grey car with active headlights is driving forward. Numerous other cars are visible further down the road, including a beige car in the middle-right lane and a light-colored car in the far background. A black motorcycle with a rider wearing a helmet is positioned in the left lane, moving forward.

Along the right side of the road, a light grey sidewalk extends through the scene. A collection of parked bicycles is visible on the sidewalk in the middle ground and to the right. Several dark green trees are positioned along the right side of the sidewalk, extending into the background.

Various buildings with different architectural styles line both sides of the road in the middle ground and background. On the left side, a light white building with a dark roof and a small structure in front is visible. On the right, a white building with brown trim and windows, and a brown roof, stands prominently next to a building with a lighter facade. Further down the street on the right, another white building with visible windows is present.

Several black poles, possibly streetlights, are distributed alongside the road and sidewalk. A traffic light showing a green signal is partially visible on the left side, in front of a building. In the right middle ground, a person with long dark hair and a dark shirt, carrying a backpack, is walking away from the viewer on the sidewalk. The sky is overcast and grey, visible above the buildings and trees in the background.

A wide asphalt road extends from the foreground to the background, with a broken white line median to the left that transitions into two solid white lines further down. The road is partly shaded by trees. In the foreground, a Mercedes-Benz hood ornament is visible. To the left of the road, a narrow sidewalk is lined with trees and a black fence. Three pedestrians are seen on the sidewalk. The first person on the left is a woman in white, looking up. The second person is a woman in a light top and white pants, facing away. The third person is a man in a red and white striped shirt and white pants, also facing away. A tall white pole is positioned near the sidewalk. Several more poles with small white signs extend along the left side of the road into the distance. To the far left, dense green vegetation is present. In the background, on the right side of the road, old European-style buildings with multiple stories and various architectural details, including dark roofs and windows, are prominent. A person on a bicycle, wearing a light blue and black backpack, is riding on the right side of the road, moving away from the viewer. Behind them, a dark grey car is parked on the right side of the road, partially visible. Further down the road, a red car is seen, and even further in the distance, more cars and a group of people are visible.

A gray asphalt road with two white dashed lines in the middle runs through the center of the image, leading into the distance. To the far left and stretching from mid-ground to the distant background, a dense line of tall, thin-trunked trees with greenish-brown autumn foliage forms a row of vegetation. To the left of the road, a dark sidewalk, partially covered with brown leaves, runs parallel to the road. Several dark brown small poles are visible along the sidewalk. To the right of the road, a narrow, gray concrete sidewalk is present. Right of the sidewalk, a row of silver and blue police cars are parked parallel to the road, with at least six cars visible, all facing the background. The police cars have blue light bars on their roofs. Behind the parked cars, a large, tan-colored building with multiple windows extends from the mid-ground to the far right of the image. In the distant background, another dark silver car is visible on the road, facing away. The sky above is mostly overcast and light gray. In the immediate foreground, a metallic silver Mercedes-Benz logo is visible, suggesting the perspective from inside a car.

A grey asphalt road with a faint white broken line in the middle, receding into the distance, with a bright, metallic Mercedes-Benz emblem visible in the bottom center foreground. To the left, a black car is parked on the sidewalk, positioned close to a large green vegetation bush. Behind the vegetation are several dark tree_trunks, and further back, off-white and grey buildings with several windows and storefronts. In the midground, on the road, a dark car with its headlights on is driving towards the viewer. Various other cars are parked along both sides of the road. On the right side, a line of cars is parked on the sidewalk. Behind these cars are light-colored buildings with several windows and doorways. There are various traffic_signs. In the background, green vegetation is dense, particularly at the top. The sky is partially visible through the trees. Several people are visible in the background on the sidewalks.

A narrow city **road** with dark grey asphalt and light grey cobblestones widens in the foreground. A dark grey curb separates the **road** from the **sidewalk** on the left. The **sidewalk** is light grey and shows patches of light green **vegetation** along the base of the left **building**. On the left, a large brown brick **building** with vertical black striped details and arched windows extends along the street on the left. In the midground, a black **car** with illuminated red taillights is parked in the middle of the **road** on the left. Another dark grey **car** with visible license plates is parked on the right side of the **road**, closer to the right **building**. A red **person** is visible in front of the second **car** on the right. On the right, a multi-story light grey **building** with detailed white window frames and a yellow awning over a door also extends along the road. A tall grey **pole** is positioned in front of this building in the midground, with a blue square **traffic sign** pointing right and a red circular **traffic sign** below it. A dark grey **bicycle** is leaning against the grey **building** directly in front of the pole. The **sky** is pale white and barely visible above the buildings at the very top.

A wide gray asphalt road in the foreground, with two continuous white lines in the center. A black motorcycle with a person riding it is in the middle-ground, moving away from the viewer. A blue car is present behind the motorcycle. To the right of the motorcycle, a red stripe painted on the road indicates a bike path. Buildings with dark roofs and white walls are visible in the background, surrounded by green vegetation. A gray pole with a green traffic light and a square yellow traffic sign is on the right side of the road. More green vegetation lines both sides of the road. The sky is partially cloudy and light gray.

A dark grey road with a white arrow marker and white dashed lines extends into the background, flanked by sidewalks on either side. On the left, a light grey sidewalk runs alongside an extensive row of multi-story buildings, primarily light grey and white, with visible windows. A bare-headed person, faintly visible, walks on the left sidewalk in the midground. In the far background, a large green tree with dense foliage stands tall, its trunk obscured behind distant buildings. On the right, a darker grey sidewalk borders a row of parked cars of various colors, including a prominent orange car in the foreground and a light grey car behind it. Beyond the parked cars, another continuous row of multi-story buildings in shades of brown and white stretches into the background. A person in a light shirt and white pants is visible on the far right sidewalk, standing next to a dark brown building. The sky above is a uniform light grey. The foreground features the top of a black car with a silver Mercedes-Benz emblem.

In the foreground, a dark gray road has light gray tram tracks running along its left side. A gray sidewalk lines the entire length of the right side of the road and another gray sidewalk is along the left side of the road. On the right side of the road, two large white traffic signs are attached to a white pole. Further along the right, a large dark green vegetation of trees is visible. In the middle ground, on the left side of the road, multiple cars are parked including a red car, a dark gray car, and multiple light gray cars. A brown car is moving away from the viewer in the distance. Along the left sidewalk, multiple multi-story building of varying shades of light gray are visible. Multiple dark gray poles are lined along both sides of the road. On the right side of the road, an abundance of green vegetation is growing along the sidewalk. In the middle ground, two people are walking side by side on the right sidewalk. The person on the left is a man wearing a white shirt and black shorts. The person to the right is a woman wearing a black shirt and black pants. On the left sidewalk, a person in a blue shirt and gray shorts is standing in front of a white building. A light gray motorcycle is parked on the left sidewalk in front of a light gray building. In the background a large expanse of white sky is visible.

A street scene with a gray road in the foreground and a silver Mercedes Benz logo on the bottom center. To the left, a light gray sidewalk with tram tracks runs parallel to the road. Two tall, dark gray buildings line the left side of the scene. The building closer to the foreground has a white H.M. flag hanging from it. A red and white pole is on the sidewalk near the left building. In the distance on the left sidewalk, two people are visible as small figures. On the right side of the road, a light gray sidewalk ends. Three cars, including a white car, a silver car, and another white car, are parked along this sidewalk. Directly to the right, a large white van is parked. Further down the road on the right, several more cars are parked in a line. A green tree with dense foliage is located above the parked cars on the right. In the center, a dark car with illuminated taillights moves away from the viewer. In the far distance, a structure that appears to be part of a bridge or overhead walkway is visible, with green elements. The sky is bright and white in the upper portion of the image.

A grey paved road occupies the foreground and midground, with a black car visible in the lower left foreground. A silver emblem is visible in the bottom center of the image. White broken lines segment the road into lanes, and solid white lines define the left edge of the road. A white concrete sidewalk with a grey curb borders the road on the right, extending into the midground. A white building with a large red “toom” logo and smaller green “BAU CENTER” sign is on the right side of the image, with green rectangular bushes in front of it. A black car is parked on the sidewalk in front of the building. In the distance, a second black car is on the road, with a silver car behind it. A white building with a red roof is visible on the left side of the image, nestled among several green trees. The sky is overcast with grey and white clouds. Numerous lampposts line both sides of the road.

Asphalt road surface in the foreground, with the front of a dark car visible at the bottom of the image, including a silver Mercedes-Benz logo. To the left, a cobblestone road, with a line of grey short poles separating it from a grey sidewalk where four people are standing. The first person from the left is a male wearing a dark t-shirt and light shorts, the second is a male with sunglasses wearing a blue shirt and white shorts, the third is a female wearing a black t-shirt and white shorts, and the fourth is a female wearing a long black sleeve shirt and white pants. In the background, on the left, several multi-story buildings are visible. A black pole with a yellow traffic light and a white and red triangular traffic sign is in the center. To the right of the traffic light, a grey statue of a person on a grey pedestal is visible amidst green vegetation used as a wall. Further to the right, a black van or minibus is parked next to multiple large green trees. The sky is partially visible at the top of the image.

A daytime street scene with a long asphalt road extending from the foreground into the background, featuring a broken white line as a lane divider on the left. The hood of a car with a prominent chrome Mercedes emblem is visible in the bottom-center. On the left side of the road, a wide, black sidewalk runs parallel, with several two-story to four-story light-colored building structures with dark storefront windows facing the street in the midground. Several parked cars, primarily silver and white, are aligned on the left sidewalk. A young person in a black dress walks along the left sidewalk, while a group of people, including a person in a white top and dark pants, and another in a light blue shirt and dark pants, stand near the buildings. Two blue trash bins stand on the left sidewalk. Further down the street on the left, more building structures are visible, some with green vegetation growing nearby. On the right side of the road, a much narrower grey sidewalk runs parallel to the street, with light-colored buildings with dark windows and graffiti on their walls bordering it. More green vegetation is visible above and around the buildings in the background. A group of people including a person in a white t-shirt and dark pants, and another in a blue shirt and dark pants, walk on the right sidewalk in the midground. An orange cylindrical trash can stands on the right sidewalk. Multiple parked cars are visible along both sidewalks, extending into the distance. Several round traffic signs are mounted on poles on the right side of the street. In the far background, two white cars are seen driving towards the camera along the road. The sky is partially visible in the top-center background, appearing clear.

A gray cobblestone road curves slightly to the right, bordered on both sides by a concrete sidewalk. In the foreground, the hood of a car with a silver Mercedes-Benz logo is visible. A dark gray car is in the midground, facing away from the viewer, with its brake lights illuminated. To the left, a tall, white cylindrical building with advertisements on its side is visible. Dark green vegetation and trees are abundant in the background and along the sides of the road. A tall, dark pole stands on the left side of the road, supporting a pole. A dark fence runs along the left sidewalk. Some building structures, including a light-colored building with windows, are visible in the background, partially obscured by trees. On the right side of the road, another dark fence and a stone wall are present.

A wide grey asphalt road curves slightly to the left in the midground and foreground, partially reflecting the sky and buildings. A silver Volkswagen car is positioned in the midground on the right side of the road, facing away from the viewer. In the background on the road, two cars are visible.  A grey asphalt sidewalk runs alongside the left of the road, with multiple brown leaves scattered on its surface. Directly behind the sidewalk, a large, dark green vegetation with thick leaves is present. To the left of the vegetation, a tall, rectangular grey building with several dark windows rises in the background. A green rectangular trash can and a large white advertisement poster featuring a man in a jersey are on the sidewalk to the left, and a black pole with a digital screen on top is located to the street side of the advertisement. In the midground on the sidewalk, a group of four people stands to the left of the vegetation, facing away from the viewer. Further down the street, more people are visible, with two individuals on bicycles. A brick building with multiple large windows stands to the right of the road. Several poles are distributed along the road in the midground, with a traffic light visible to the left. The sky, covered in grey clouds, occupies the upper portion of the image.

A grey asphalt road dominates the foreground, with a metallic Mercedes-Benz emblem visible at the bottom center. To the left, a black car, possibly a station wagon, is parked, displaying a white license plate and some colorful stickers on its rear. Further up the road and parked along the curb, a dark grey sedan is visible, with a license plate. A row of various dark-colored cars extends into the midground along the left side of the road. On either side of the road, green vegetation, including large bushes, lines the scene. In the midground, to the right of the parked vehicles, a small pile of green vegetation is present on the roadside. In the distance, a large white truck is visible. The buildings on the left are a mix of light beige and darker red-brown facades, with numerous windows. In the background, to the right, there are more buildings. A dark grey sky is visible above the buildings and vegetation. Several tall, full green trees are interspersed throughout the scene, particularly on the left behind the buildings and in the midground on the right. A dark grey pole with a light fixture at its top extends upwards on the right side of the road, in front of some vegetation.

A road paved with dark gray cobblestone bricks extends from the foreground towards the background, partially covered with dry, light brown leaves. In the middle ground, on the right side of the road, a brick wall extends towards the background adorned with light brown leaves on the ground. A black wire fence is positioned on the right side of the brick wall, parallel to the road. Two traffic signs are mounted on a dark pole, one circular with a blue background and white arrow pointing right, and another a triangular yield sign with a white background and red border. In the mid-ground, a white car, possibly a tram or bus, with long rectangular black window panes is facing left and partially visible from behind parked cars. A small, blue car with a gray top and partially visible front is parked on the left of the road, and an orange car is parked behind the blue car. A bicycle is parked on a sidewalk on the left, next to a black pole. In the background, a row of residential buildings with visible dark-colored roofs and white facades extend towards the end of the road. A white building with a brown roof with four light-colored rectangular windows is present on the right side of the other residential buildings.

A dark gray road extends from the foreground to the midground and across the width of the image, showing an intersection with white painted crosswalk lines. A large, reflective silver Mercedes-Benz logo is visible at the bottom center of the image, suggesting the perspective is from inside a car. On the left side of the road, a dark gray sidewalk runs parallel, extending towards the midground. Another dark gray sidewalk is present to the right of the road. In the midground and background, a row of multi-story buildings lines both sides of the street. The buildings at the center are predominantly light pink with gray lower sections, featuring numerous windows and dark brown doors. Balconies with black fences are visible on several upper floors. To the left, white buildings with black balconies are present. Towards the far right, a dark blue car and a brown bicycle are parked on the sidewalk. Several gray poles are distributed throughout the scene, supporting various traffic signs and traffic lights. A red circular traffic light with a yellow light is visible on the left, next to a black and white no-entry traffic sign. Another red traffic light with a red light is positioned further right. A white and gray traffic sign with multiple arrows and text in French is located on the right sidewalk. In the fore- to midground left, a large red spherical object is attached to a pole. A bus stop or similar structure featuring a transparent rectangular surface with an advertisement is visible on the far left.

A view from inside a car of a narrow asphalt road in Germany on a cloudy day. In the foreground, the silver Mercedes-Benz hood ornament is visible. On the right side of the road, three parked cars are visible, including a dark green car, a silver car, and a black car. On the left side of the road, three cars are facing the camera; a silver BMW is parked closest, and two dark-colored cars are driving towards the camera. The pavement is dark with leaves scattered on the ground. A gray sidewalk runs along the left side of the road and a lighter gray sidewalk along the right side. On the left, a light brown building with numerous glass windows is visible. A dark green tree with leafy vegetation covering a large portion of its trunk is in front of the building. In the background, on the right, several trees are scattered around; behind them, a white residential building with multiple windows can be seen. On the far left, a brick building with a few windows and some vegetation at the top is visible. A person on a bicycle is riding in the background on the left side of the road. A white triangular traffic sign with a red border and a black exclamation point is on the right side of the road. Other white traffic signs are also visible in the distance. The sky above is light gray and overcast.

A wet road with white dashed lines extends from the foreground to the mid-ground. On the left side of the road, several parked cars are visible, alongside a sidewalk and a white building. Further down the road on the left, more buildings are present. On the right side of the road in the foreground, there is a sidewalk with a light pole, and a "30 ZONE" traffic sign attached to it. A group of people are gathered on this sidewalk, some carrying backpacks. Behind them is a treeline with dense green vegetation, and further back, another building with a gray wall. In the top-left and top-right sections of the image, the sky is partially visible. The Mercedes-Benz car hood ornament is visible in the bottom center of the image.

A long, wet asphalt road extends into midground. A dark gray car is in the foreground, with part of its hood and windshield visible. A silver Mercedes-Benz logo is visible on the hood. On the wet gray road to the left, a white car, a light gray car, and a red car are parked. Further back on the left, more parked cars are visible, including a dark car and a black van. A tall black pole stands in the middle ground on the left. On the right side of the wet road in the foreground, part of a gray car is visible. Behind it, a dark black car and a blue car are parked. In the midground, a long line of various sized dark-colored cars is parked on the right. In the background, in the distance, a white car drives toward the camera in the middle of the road. On both sides of the road, the sidewalk is dark gray, and numerous large trees with green foliage line the street. Several tall, dark red buildings with windows are visible behind the trees on either side of the road. The sky is light gray and partially covered with clouds.

A narrow, dark gray road in the foreground, with a circular manhole cover visible on its surface. To the left of the road, a dark gray sidewalk runs alongside a light gray building with three arched white-framed windows and a yellowish base. Further down the sidewalk, a tall, rough-textured gray wall with some visible posters on it. Above the wall, dark green vegetation is visible. On the right side of the road, a white van is parked, facing away from the viewer. Behind the white van, a silver car is parked, followed by two more cars of the same color, all parked along the side of the street. In the mid-ground, on the right, a white building with several white-framed windows is visible. A blue and white parking sign is attached to a pole in front of this building. Further down the road, a red truck is visible in the distance. In the background, a tall, cylindrical building with dark horizontal stripes stands against the sky. The sky above is partially visible, appearing bright.

A dark grey road in the foreground and stretching into the distance towards the top-center is bordered on both sides by green vegetation. A white solid single line is centrally located on the left side of the road, and additional broken white lines are on its right side. A small part of the vehicle's hood, dark grey in color with a Mercedes-Benz emblem, is visible at the very bottom-center. A blue car is directly in front of the vehicle, slightly to the left of the center. Approaching the middle-right of the image, the road widens to include a parking area, where a blue car, two dark grey cars, and a trailer with a silver car are parked along the sidewalk. The sidewalk, light grey and visible on the right, is covered with brown leaves. Tall trees with dark brown trunks and dense green foliage line both sides of the road, creating an arch like entrance. In the top-center, a bright yellow traffic sign with black symbols indicates directions.

A dark grey road in the foreground, textured with a cobblestone pattern, stretching into the background. In the lower center, the Mercedes-Benz emblem is visible, reflecting off what appears to be the hood of a car. To the left of the road, a dark grey Audi car with its headlights on is moving towards the viewer. Behind the Audi, a light grey building with multiple windows is visible. Directly behind the vehicle is a small area of green vegetation. To the right of the road, a light grey sidewalk extends along the right side of the road. Further down the street, on the right side of the frame, a tall, dark grey pole stands upright, a dark grey garbage bin and a yellow garbage bin sit on the sidewalk, between the pole and garbage bins, there is a silver fence. Further along the road in the background, another dark grey car and a white car are parked on the left side, and a dark grey car on the right side. On either side of the road, lines of tall, green vegetation and trees are present. The wall of a light grey building is visible to the right of the left-hand vegetation, while another light grey building is visible to the left of the right-hand vegetation. The sky is dark grey.

A city road with dark asphalt pavement in the foreground features a white continuous line on the left and white dashed lines on the right, marking the lanes. Overhead, a cloudy, light gray sky covers the scene. In the center, a red bus follows the road, displaying a white striped emblem on its rear. To the left, a dark gray car is parked on the sidewalk. Alongside the front buildings, multiple gray buildings with brown roofing are visible in the background. On the right, several cars are parked on the sidewalk: a white car, a black car, an orange car, and a dark blue car, all partially covered with green vegetation. The road is bordered by a long row of green vegetation on both sides, with several tall, leafy trees standing near the road. The far left of the scene shows a brown building with several windows. Additionally, a black traffic sign containing a blue arrow and an upward white arrow on the left of the road, and another traffic sign with a blue P for parking and white arrows on the right, provide navigational information. A black street light post is located on the right of the road in the midground, with a red traffic light attached to it.

A broad grey road occupies the foreground, extending upwards to the center of the image. White crosswalk lines are painted on the road in the mid-right. A grey Mercedes-Benz emblem is visible in the lower center of the image. The road transitions into a grey sidewalk in the center and to the mid-right.

On the left side of the image, two dark grey buildings with multiple windows are visible. Large green vegetation is present in the mid-left and center, consisting of leafy trees. A dark grey street pole with a light circular form is to the left of the vegetation. In front of the vegetation and to the right, a dark grey traffic sign with a blue rectangular shape and white symbols is visible. Below it is another horizontal elliptical dark grey traffic sign.

A large grey building with multiple windows fills the right side of the image, with a dark brown cylindrical pillar in front of it. Another dark brown cylindrical pillar is in the mid-right.

Numerous people are present on the sidewalks. In the mid-left, a person wearing a white shirt and light brown skirt walks leftward. To their right, a person in a white shirt and white shorts pulls a black suitcase. Adjacent to them, a person in a pink shirt and white pants walks towards the right. To their right, a person in a blue and white patterned shirt walks towards the right. Another person in a white hat and white dress walks rightward near the center. More people are scattered across the scene.

Several bicycles are parked on the sidewalks: a grey bicycle with a brown seat to the far left, a grey bicycle with a black seat near the center, and a grey bicycle with a green basket in the mid-right.

The sky is visible in the upper right.

A gray road occupies the foreground and midground, featuring white dashed and solid lane markings. A manhole cover is visible on the road in the midground. To the left of the road, a green vegetation area separates the road from a white billboard featuring a man's portrait and text, situated in the midground. Behind the billboard, a multi-story building with dark windows and a prominent white satellite dish is partially visible. Further back, a dense line of dark green vegetation (trees) forms a solid backdrop across the midground. In the center of the road in the midground, a man wearing a bright green shirt rides a bicycle, moving away from the viewer. Behind him, a dark-colored car is partially visible. To the right of the road, a gray sidewalk runs alongside a building with a dark brick lower section and light gray upper stories with dark windows. A person in dark attire stands on the sidewalk in the midground, facing towards the right. A dark-colored pole and a black traffic light are also visible on the right side of the road. In the immediate foreground, a silver Mercedes-Benz emblem is centered on the vehicle's hood, which is reflected on the top right. A clear sky is visible above the buildings and trees on the right side of the image.

A gray road occupies the foreground and mid-ground with white crosswalk lines on it. A dark gray pole stands on the left sidewalk. A medium green vegetation is to the pole's left. A building with a brick wall base and multiple glass windows stands behind and to the pole's left. A brown car is parked on the sidewalk in front of the building's wall. A blue car is parked to the right of the brown car. A row of various colored cars is parked along the right side of the road, extending into the background. Another building with balconies on the third and fourth floors is to the right of the first building. More buildings are visible in the background forming a street. The sky, partially cloudy, is above the buildings in the background.

A street view with multiple cars on the road and buildings lining both sides. In the foreground, the hood of a car with a silver Mercedes-Benz logo is visible at the bottom center. A black car, possibly a BMW, is in front of the Mercedes-Benz with a white arrow painted on the road pointing towards it. To the right of the street, another black car (a Nissan) is visible with its brake lights illuminated, followed by a silver car (a Skoda Octavia). A white traffic sign with a blue circle and an upward pointing arrow is mounted on a brown pole with a Hotel Pedrera sign to its right. A red traffic light hanging from a black pole on the right side of the road shows a red light with three vertical segments.
